## Overview

I used the Google Analytics 4 demo account to understand how users moved through a conversion funnel from homepage view to purchase.

My purpose was to identify which stage of the journey created the greatest loss of users and then translate that finding into a practical recommendation for improving customer engagement.

## Key Findings

- 38,514 homepage views began the funnel.
- 335 users moved to Add to Cart, a conversion rate of about 0.87%.
- 124 users continued to Add Payment.
- 83 users completed purchase.
- The largest performance issue appeared at the homepage-to-add-to-cart stage.

## Recommendation

Improve homepage product visibility and calls-to-action, then test changes through A/B experiments. The next investigation should segment funnel performance by device type and traffic source.

## Professional Takeaway

This project helped me see how GA4 can move beyond passive reporting. The funnel gives a clear behavioral signal, and the recommendation connects directly to user experience, homepage messaging, and conversion optimization.
